### 2. "Skulking" Meaning

The verb [skulking](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/skulking) means to **hide, sneak, or move around furtively** so as not to be seen, often out of cowardice, shame, or hidden intentions. 

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)Cambridge Dictionary +1

### 3. "Bawing" vs. "Bawling"

"Bawing" is likely a typo for **bawling** (crying loudly). When paired with "teardrop," this creates a picture of someone weeping heavily or hiding away out of sadness.

### 4. A Scientific Alternative: Prince Rupert's Drops

If you aren't referring to the pop song, you might be thinking of a [Prince Rupert's Drop](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/prince-ruperts-drop). These are unique **teardrop-shaped** glass beads created by dropping molten glass into cold water. They have a bulbous head that can survive hammer blows, but if their thin tail is nipped, the entire structure explosively shatters.
